patch_description:
This version keeps the unit-square hull, preserving exact normalized-area evaluation, but replaces the single-proposal annealing loop with a batched tail-guided search. Each iteration generates multiple coordinated candidate moves around points involved in the currently smallest triangles, evaluates all candidates vectorially, and selects according to a lexicographic low-tail objective: maximize the true minimum double-area first, then improve the mean of the smallest triangle areas.

The novel component is a deterministic active-constraint search: rather than smoothing every triangle equally, it repeatedly identifies the current bottleneck triangle graph, selects participating movable vertices, and tests a population of directional, isotropic, and reflected proposals. This gives substantially more useful local exploration per determinant evaluation. A final strict polish retains only lexicographic improvements, directly incorporating the recommended low-tail selection strategy.
